headline: Stolen Financial Records from Carlex Glass America, LLC Leaked Online
body: In a follow-up to the recent ransomware attack, Carlex Glass America, LLC has reported that the attackers have leaked stolen financial records online. The breach, which led to a partial operational shutdown, also affected the company's ability to fulfill orders. Carlex Glass America, LLC continues to collaborate with cybersecurity experts to recover its systems and mitigate further damage.
